headline: Private Gulet Charter Turkey - Curated Luxury Gulet Fleet
primaryText: Tailor-made private gulet charters in Turkey, curated for your dates, guests, and style. Professional crew... (cut off)
whyItWorks: The headline puts the exact search term first, so it matches what a high-intent traveller typed, and 'curated luxury' signals a premium tier. The description stresses personalisation around dates, guests and style, which lowers the worry that a charter is one-size-fits-all. The photo of a gulet in clear turquoise water sells the experience, and the sitelinks (yachts and prices, destinations, plan your charter) give several easy next steps for different stages of research.
